dct_description_sm: Abstract: Nairobi, Kenya street centerline vectors with road type attributes extracted from DigitalGlobe QuickBird CitySphere high-resolution (60cm) satellite imagery ortho mosaics.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic GIS applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production.
